info.name: analytics-api Postman Collection
info.description:
Insights and metrics aggregation service. Collects data from Enhancement, 
Assessment, and Scheduler services to provide real-time dashboards, 
trend analysis, and productivity reports.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0
